user.title: MapleCUN
user.description: IP of the host running maplecun-splitproxy and the role of each radio module. Without proxy: module 1 on port 2323 of the MapleCUN, others off.

data.init_mode: Set receive mode on connect (X21, brs/brt)

data_description.init_mode: Recommended. Puts each module into its role's mode and checks the firmware reply. Wireless M-Bus C needs culfw; a-culfw 1.26 only knows S and T. Only one module at a time can be in a Wireless M-Bus mode.
data_description.it_codes: 10-digit tristate codes as in FHEM, e.g. FFFF0F0FFF. On = FF, off = F0.

error.invalid_code: Invalid code: exactly 10 characters of 0, 1, F, D.
error.wmbus_exclusive: Only one module can receive Wireless M-Bus at a time: a-culfw switches the others off when a wMBus mode is set (clib/rf_mode.c).

data.init_mode: Set receive mode on connect (X21, brs/brt)

data_description.init_mode: Recommended. Puts each module into its role's mode and checks the firmware reply. Wireless M-Bus C needs culfw; a-culfw 1.26 only knows S and T. Only one module at a time can be in a Wireless M-Bus mode.

add_meter.title: Wireless M-Bus meter
add_meter.description: The ID is printed on the meter or shown in FHEM (e.g. WMBUS_LSE_52143909 → 52143909). The list suggests meters heard since startup that are not set up yet (strongest signal first, currently {count}); you can also type an ID. Only header data of other meters is kept, in memory only.

data_description.key: AES-128 key of the meter (32 hex characters). Used for security modes 5 and 7 and for encrypted extended link layer (Kamstrup). Leave empty for unencrypted meters.

discovered.title: Found devices
discovered.description: {found} devices were received but are not set up yet. Tick the ones you want. Meters are sorted by signal strength – your own are usually the strongest.

data.ignore_rest: Ignore all unticked from now on

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Set up newly received devices immediately without asking. Currently ignored: {ignored}. Wireless M-Bus meters are never collected automatically: telegrams of meters not configured here are discarded.

data.log_unknown_meters: Write unknown wireless M-Bus meters to the log (ID, type, RSSI only)

data_description.log_unknown_meters: Diagnostics for finding your own meter IDs. Nothing is stored. Off by default.

data_description.key: AES-128 key of the meter (32 hex characters). Used for security modes 5 and 7 and for encrypted extended link layer (Kamstrup). Leave empty for unencrypted meters.

import_fhem.title: Import FHEM log
import_fhem.description:
Imports old Wireless M-Bus telegrams from an FHEM log (lines “WMBUS Unknown device b…::-56.5”). Only meters set up here are imported, everything else is discarded. **Create a backup first** – the import writes long-term statistics.

The file is deleted right after reading. Next step: dry run with report.

data.overwrite: Overwrite existing hours in the statistics

import_report.title: Dry run
import_report.description:
{report}

Nothing has been written yet. **Create a backup before importing.**

error.invalid_code: Invalid code: exactly 10 characters of 0, 1, F, D.
error.invalid_cmd: Invalid: exactly 2 characters of 0, 1, F, D.
error.file_error: The file could not be read.
error.wmbus_exclusive: Only one module can receive Wireless M-Bus at a time: a-culfw switches the others off when a wMBus mode is set (clib/rf_mode.c).

options.wmbus_c: Wireless M-Bus C (868.95 MHz, culfw only)

import_fhem_log.name: Import FHEM log
import_fhem_log.description: Reads old Wireless M-Bus telegrams from an FHEM log, sets the current meter values and imports long-term statistics. Only meters set up in the integration are used.

path.name: Path
path.description: File below /config (must be an allowed path), e.g. /config/meine_zaehler.txt.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only analyse and report, write nothing (default).

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Overwrite hours that already exist in the statistics.
